backward_sync_limit_date.description: Date Limit of the Historical Sync Time for selected tables. The Format should be YYYY-MM-DD.

client_secret.description: Client secret for private custom app authentication.

historical_sync_time_frame.description: Used to configure Historical sync timeframe for selected tables.

sync_highly_sensitive_data.description: Enable syncing of highly sensitive data fields from HubSpot. When enabled, sensitive data syncing is also automatically enabled.

sync_sensitive_data.description: Enable syncing of sensitive data fields from HubSpot.

tables_without_access_updated_at.description: Timestamp to indicate when tables without access was updated.

client_id.description: `Client ID` of your HubSpot client application.

client_secret.description: `Client Secret` of your HubSpot client application.

refresh_token.description: The long-lived `Refresh token` along with the `client_id` and `client_secret` parameters carry the information necessary to get a new access token for API resources.
